text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal! Agnes Tachyon puts her immense 
talent on full display!

Much about her remains shrouded in 
mystery— yet the way she ran was as 
captivating as ever.
choice_data_list: (I really do love watching you run...!)
(I really do love watching you run...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see... This is quite... intriguing.
choice_data_list: Good work! That was a great run!

text_block_list.text:
Although running in the Nippon Derby—which 
had originally been set as our goal—was 
not meant to be...

"I really don't want to give up on our 
original rotation after all. I want her to 
run in the Kikuka Sho."
choice_data_list: Next, let's enter the Kikuka Sho!
Let us enter the Kikuka Sho next!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, your next GⅠ race, the Kikuka Sho, 
was firmly scheduled on your rotation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I don't mind you aiming for it! 
However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just like this time, don't get your hopes 
up too high!

Agnes Tachyon is whimsical. For now, I 
intend to keep it as a goal, but—

Left in a state of limbo, the days aiming 
for the Kikuka Sho began...!
